summary: An experimental release-candidate synth firmware with five selectable synthesis modes across four parts, built from Felucca and Golana engine code. Much of it is not yet verified on hardware.
features: Modes: KORG, BRUTE, ANALOG, LOFI and an experimental B1 bass engine
49 presets: 32 user slots plus 17 Felucca ANALOG and LOFI factory sounds
B1 is not yet a faithful model of the Donner Essential B1
MUSIC DISK flash store for patterns, songs and albums
USB audio and MIDI, with device and MIDI host profiles in development
Back up presets first; recovery may need a separate flashing route

headings: rc2: firmware hub identity and publication
